name: Spinarak
flavorText: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

attacks.name: Gooey Thread
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

attacks.name: Send Flowers
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Grass Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Servine
flavorText: Servine’s one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

name: Serperior
flavorText: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

attacks.name: Regal Command
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Solar Coiling
attacks.text: If Rosa's Encouragement is in your discard pile, this attack does 150 more damage.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands where flowers bloom.

attacks.name: Blow Through
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

abilities.name: Grand Wing
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 4 cards.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to nestle into its Trainer’s bag or the front of their jacket.

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.

attacks.name: Feather Shot
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Crushing Arrow
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sniper's Eye
abilities.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers as it flies.

abilities.name: Sky Hunt
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Dire Nails
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

attacks.name: Heat Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

abilities.name: Shell Spikes
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Seel
flavorText: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: It stores thermal energy in its body to fend off the cold. It swims at eight knots even in frigid waters.

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Water Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Staryu
flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

attacks.name: Jetting Blow
attacks.text: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Nebula Beam
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Turn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Amaura
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Aurorus
flavorText: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

attacks.name: Freezing Chill
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

abilities.name: Tundra Wall
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have any Water Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Tundra Wall doesn't stack.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

attacks.name: Powerful Steam
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

name: Luxio
flavorText: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

abilities.name: Fighting Roar
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

attacks.name: Incessant Onslaught
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card you have taken.

attacks.name: Strong Volt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

attacks.name: Tail Generator
attacks.text: Choose Basic Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile up to the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon and attach them to your Lightning Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

attacks.name: Shooting Moons
attacks.text: You may discard up to 4 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

abilities.name: Luminous Wing
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

attacks.name: Double Eater
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Espurr
flavorText: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don’t get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Spritzee
flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Aromatisse
flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless they happen to really enjoy the smell, Trainers will have a hard time walking alongside it.

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Scent Collection
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby iron objects to its body.

name: Probopass
flavorText: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it’s around.

attacks.name: Obliterating Nose
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

attacks.name: Twister Spewing
attacks.text: If you played Tarragon from your hand during this turn, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Screw Knuckle
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

name: Binacle
flavorText: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head’s orders.

abilities.name: Stone Arms
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Fighting Pokémon.

name: Tyrunt
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

attacks.name: Get Angry
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

name: Tyrantrum
flavorText: This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million years ago. Nothing could stop it.

attacks.name: Wreak Havoc
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

abilities.name: Tyrannically Gutsy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +150 HP.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

attacks.name: Vengeful Kick
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Gaia Wave
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Nullifying Zero
attacks.text: For each of your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 150 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Gastly
flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal its victim’s life-force. It lurks in darkness, waiting for prey.

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Place 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Gengar
flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Infinite Shadow
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

name: Skorupi
flavorText: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Drapion
flavorText: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

attacks.name: Hazardous Tail
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Soul Destroyer
attacks.text: Knock Out each of your opponent's Pokémon that has 50 HP or less remaining.

attacks.name: Dark Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dark Strike.

name: Chien-Pao
flavorText: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rising Blade
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Ripper
attacks.text: Shuffle all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your deck, and this attack does 220 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Honedge
flavorText: Apparently Honedge was born when a departed spirit began inhabiting an ancient sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

attacks.name: Weaponized Swords
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Honedge, Doublade, and Aegislash from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any oppenent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

attacks.name: Metal Slash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

name: Klefki
flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

attacks.name: Memory Lock
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Raticate
flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

attacks.name: Scrape Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Retaliatory Incisors
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.

attacks.name: Tuck Tail
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

abilities.name: Last-Ditch Catch
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Ability that has "Last-Ditch" in its name each turn.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach’s digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn’t bother it at all.

attacks.name: Gormandizer
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through without rest.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

attacks.name: Chirp
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon with Fighting Resistance, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

attacks.name: Hand Trim
attacks.text: Discard random cards from your opponent's hand until they have 5 cards in their hand.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic [Colorless] Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

abilities.name: Intimidating Jaw
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic [Colorless] Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

abilities.name: Protective Sail
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Geobuster
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose an Energy card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Supporter
attacks.text: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your [Psychic] Pokémon.

attacks.name: Supporter
attacks.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

attacks.name: Stadium
attacks.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Supporter
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. Before drawing cards, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. (If you can't draw any cards in this way, you can't use this card.)

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Supporter
attacks.text: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

attacks.name: Supporter
attacks.text: Put up to 4 in any combination of [Fighting] Pokémon and Basic [Fighting] Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Special Energy
attacks.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides [Grass] Energy. The [Grass] Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.

attacks.name: Special Energy
attacks.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides [Fighting] Energy. Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the [Fighting] Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Special Energy
attacks.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides [Psychic] Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to a [Psychic] Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic [Psychic] Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Item
attacks.text: Shuffle up to 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

attacks.name: Stadium
attacks.text: Each player's [Grass] Pokémon can evolve into [Grass] Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn.

attacks.text: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your [Psychic] Pokémon.
